description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. The class provides mechanisms for shared, process-wide cyclic buffer management, including locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration. It includes nested classes and methods for buffer operations, synchronization, and access control, with platform-specific handling for Windows and non-Windows systems.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class for managing a shared, process-wide cyclic buffer with locking, reading, writing, and buffer administration functionalities.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A nested helper class for peeking and navigating within the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the cyclic buffer with file parameters or existing buffer.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Acquire exclusive access to the buffer, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Release the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Read data from the buffer, destructive operation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Write data into the buffer, advancing the head pointer.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserve space in the buffer for future writes.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Notify that data is available in the buffer.
